    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Online Order Fulfilment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfilment"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PlaceOrderOnline" name="Places order online" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PlaceOrderPhone" name="Places order by phone" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_PhoneOrder"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HandoverToLogistics" name="Hand over order" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOver" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PhoneOrder" name="Order placed by phone">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordDelivery" name="Record successful delivery">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" name="Handle feedback or return">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReceived"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>

A diagram element with no plane child is schema-invalid.

rules.instruction: When the description says a case can enter the process through one of several alternative channels, each a separate way to start it, and the channels then share one continuation: Model each alternative channel as its own entry path, starting with a start event and containing the task or catching event that the channel performs. Route every entry path into a single exclusive (merge) gateway, and connect that gateway to the shared continuation. Do not merge alternative channels with a parallel gateway, and do not collapse them into one task that represents all channels.
rules.situation: the description says a case can enter the process through one of several alternative channels, each a separate way to start it, and the channels then share one continuation

rules.instruction: When The description states that the process begins when an external party performs an action through a channel, or that it ends after a stated final result, and that result is not a work step performed by a participant.: Model the opening action as a start event and the stated final result as an end event, each labeled with the trigger or outcome named in the description. Do not model these as tasks.
rules.situation: The description states that the process begins when an external party performs an action through a channel, or that it ends after a stated final result, and that result is not a work step performed by a participant.

rules.instruction: When the description says that one case can begin through alternative channels (for example, several ways a request can be received), and each channel is a manual step by which the same case enters the process: Model a single start event for the process. Model one activity for each alternative channel, placed after the start event. Merge the channel activities with an exclusive gateway, and continue the common flow from that gateway. Do not create one start event per channel when the channels lead to the same case.
rules.situation: the description says that one case can begin through alternative channels (for example, several ways a request can be received), and each channel is a manual step by which the same case enters the process

rules.instruction: When the description states that a process ends once a final outcome is reached, while a later event such as customer feedback or a return may start additional steps that the main flow does not require: Model the final outcome as an explicit task placed before the end event. After the activity that leads to that outcome, place an exclusive gateway with one branch to the outcome and end event and a second branch to the optional follow-up path. Start the follow-up path from an intermediate catch event for the later trigger, or from a separate process or event subprocess, and join it back into the main flow only where the description says the process can continue. Do not drop the outcome step, the decision gateway, or the optional follow-up branch.
